newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil central bank bond rate drops to 2.614 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil central bank bond rate drops to 2.614 pct.

text.p: Brazil's benchmark overnight rate dropped to 2.614 percent a month from 2.621 percent last week at today's 7.250 billion real sale of 56-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC), dealers said.
The auction's result was in line with market expectations, they added.
The 56-day bonds will mature on December 25. Today's auction is expected to add 250 million reais to the banking system, with 7.5 billion reais in old bonds maturing Wednesday.
